newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 7.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 7.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 71.77 points or 0.88 percent to close at a new record of 8259.31.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index gained 6.66 points or 0.7 percent to 951.74 on a rebound from falls earlier in the week.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.6300/30 a dollar at around 0043 GMT, a bit higher from 2.6350/80 at its Kuala Lumpur ending on Wednesday.
* The overnight interbank rate fell sharply to 5.5 percent on aggressive lending by foreign banks long on ringgit, from 8.2 percent on Tuesday.

* Bank Negara said Malaysia's broad money M3 expanded by 21.9 percent year-on-year in June, against 20.3 percent in May. Total annual loans growth stood at 30 percent at the end of June against 29.5 percent at the end of May.
* Property firm Bandar Raya reported net profit rise of three percent to 65.17 million ringit for the six months to June 30.
* Public Finance said its net profit rose 16 pcercent to 56.81 million ringit for the first half-year to June 30.
* Southern Bank reported a 36 percent rise in net earnings to 71.15 million ringgit for the year to end-June.
